question: Does the finite seam-generated/no-spectator repair also fix absolute source normalization, and is its commutant helper invariant under equivalent complex bases?
kills: Finite seam cyclicity and a scalar joint commutant alone determine the absolute scalar Hamiltonian/source normalization.
The original v1020 real-stacked commutant helper correctly computes complex commutant dimension in every equivalent complex basis.
summary_de: Querverbindung am Originalmodell v1020: Naht-Zyklizität und Kommutant bleiben unter H+cI gleich, die unnormierte Zustandssumme ändert sich. No-Spectator-Auswahl ersetzt daher keine absolute Quellen-Normierung. Zusätzlich Basisfehler der Kommutanten-Hilfsfunktion nachgewiesen: am Ausnahmeimpuls nach komplexem Basiswechsel 1 statt 58; korrekte komplexe Rechnung bleibt 58. Die ursprünglichen reellen Prüfdaten bleiben gültig.
summary_en: Cross-check of original v1020: seam cyclicity and joint commutant are invariant under H+cI while the unnormalized partition function changes. No-spectator selection therefore does not supply absolute source normalization. A helper-domain bug is also witnessed: at the exceptional momentum a complex basis change produces 1 instead of 58; complex-rank computation preserves 58. Original real-input checks remain valid.
scope: Finite linear-algebra cross-check of the existing model and abstract normalization criterion; no proof that scalar shifts are admissible original TFPT source deformations, no fixed-Fermi-level covariance equivalence, no 4D reconstruction.
positive_results: Finite seam Krylov span and joint commutant are invariant under scalar Hamiltonian shifts.
Original real-basis v1020 witness reproduced: 9 checks pass.
Complex-rank calculation preserves commutant dimension under the tested diagonal unitary basis change.
leaves_open: Derive the original source-defined off-shell operator/reference/domain family and its absolute geometric normalization.
Establish whether any nontrivial normalization change is actually admissible under the original TFPT source; the finite shift test does not establish this.
assumptions: Finite Hermitian one-particle Hamiltonian and the exact seam seed projector from v1020.
Same positive-beta normalized Gibbs state prescription and same instruments for the scalar-shift comparison.
Diagnostic basis transformation is unitary; it is not a proposed new physical interaction.
next_discriminating_test: Before claiming no-spectator closure fixes gravity, identify the source-derived absolute normalization observable and show that its value is fixed by the original geometric operator/reference/domain family. Further normalized matter-only checks do not distinguish the tested scalar freedom.
not_claimed: No invariant fixed-chemical-potential Fermi covariance under H+cI.
No fully admissible pair of alternative original TFPT sources.
